Accelerate Bench task · Scientific I/O

The IO500-derived task exercises parallel file I/O and filesystem metadata operations.

Workload

The MPI workload runs the prescribed IOR reads and writes, metadata creation, lookup and deletion, and parallel file search.

Correctness

The verifier checks file data, metadata operations and the required retention and deletion of files.
